title: Broken Images & Media Library
description: Fix images not displaying, wrong paths after migration, missing thumbnails, and media library showing blank thumbnails.

steps.title: Identify Broken Image Pattern
steps.instructions: Note if all images fail, only uploads, only thumbnails, or only images in content. Check if URLs point to wrong domain or http instead of https.

steps.title: Fix URL Mismatch After Migration
steps.instructions: Run serialization-safe search-replace for old upload URL. Verify upload_url_path and upload_path options in database are correct or empty for default.

steps.title: Verify Physical Files Exist on Server
steps.instructions: Check wp-content/uploads/year/month/ via SFTP. Missing files need restore from backup — database references alone cannot recreate images.

steps.title: Regenerate Thumbnails
steps.instructions: After theme switch or image size changes, regenerate thumbnails with Regenerate Thumbnails plugin or WP-CLI. Large libraries should run via CLI to avoid timeouts.

steps.title: Check Hotlink Protection and CDN
steps.instructions: Server hotlink rules or CDN misconfiguration can block image loading. Verify CDN origin path matches uploads directory.

steps.title: Fix Upload Directory Permissions
steps.instructions: Ensure wp-content/uploads is readable by the web server (755 dirs, 644 files). Wrong permissions cause 403 on image URLs.

steps.title: Fix Mixed Content Image URLs
steps.instructions: Images hardcoded as http:// on an https site may be blocked. Search-replace or use SSL plugin to rewrite image URLs to https.

steps.title: Verify Images on Front End and Library
steps.instructions: Spot-check media library thumbnails, featured images, galleries, and inline content images. Test on mobile and after cache purge.
